sloka: अथ मध्यमकक्ष्यायाम् समागच्छत् सुहृज्जनैः ।स सर्वान् अर्थिनो दृष्ट्वा समेत्य प्रतिनन्द्य च ॥२-१६-२७॥
transliteration: atha madhyamakakṣyāyām samāgacchat suhṛjjanaiḥ ।sa sarvān arthino dṛṣṭvā sametya pratinandya ca ॥2-16-27॥

translations.english: Rama, the best among men, met all his friends in the middle courtyard. Having seen them all eager to see him, he approached and greeted them. Thereafter, he mounted the best silver chariot covered with tigerskin and glowing like fire.
translations.hindi: जब इस प्रकार केकेयी ने श्रीरामचन्द्र जी से कहा तब श्रीरामचन्द्र जी अत्यन्त व्यथित हो महाराज के. पास बैठी हुई कैकेयी से बोले
